revenue_scope: Six previously selected largest production misses; source gaps remain blocked
revenue_proxy: Prior-year reported retail revenue per gallon plus year-over-year EIA weighted retail price change
same_store_comparison: Reported same-store gallon growth only; no growth inferred from changing-store-base volume tables
forward_cutoff: End of the calendar quarter two quarter-index steps before target; e.g. Q3 forecast at March31
availability_rule: Verified original result publication date strictly before cutoff; unresolved dates excluded
limitations: Current archived outcomes are not a complete original-target revision audit
Revenue proxy mixes product, taxes, geography and gallon/time weights
Implied cost residual uses actual margin and is not causal attribution
No new forward production model is authorized by benchmark performance
